about.heading: About Me
about.paragraph_1: I've been doing frontend development for over 7 years, with a lot of that time in digital banking projects. React and Angular are where I feel most at home, but I'm always learning something new. I care genuinely about accessibility and WCAG standards — it's not just a checkbox for me.
about.paragraph_2: Right now I'm focused on getting better, as a developer and as a person. I want to keep growing, take on harder problems, and find a team where I can show what I'm actually capable of.
about.paragraph_3: Based in Heredia, Costa Rica. Always building something.

experience.heading: Experience
experience.autodesk_note: Contract ended due to company-wide layoffs in January 2026

experience.autodesk_bullet_1: Tracked down some rendering bottlenecks and bundle issues that added up to about a 10% performance improvement.
experience.autodesk_bullet_2: Worked closely with designers in Figma to get implementations right, matching specs down to spacing and color tokens.
experience.autodesk_bullet_3: Made sure components worked consistently across Chrome, Firefox, Safari and Edge.
experience.therapp_bullet_0: Built the main user flows from scratch: auth, multi-step forms, and dashboards. Integrated the backend APIs and owned the global state setup with Redux and React Context.
experience.therapp_bullet_1: Small team, so I had a lot of ownership over architecture decisions. Moved fast but kept things organized.
experience.therapp_bullet_2: Turned Figma designs into responsive components and kept things consistent across the codebase.

experience.loyalty_bullet_1: Looked into some slow content delivery issues and after optimizing the pipeline, static response times dropped by 30%.
experience.loyalty_bullet_2: Integrated third-party APIs using OAuth in a regulated fintech environment, working closely with backend and security teams.
experience.loyalty_bullet_3: Collaborated with UX on Figma designs and built accessible Angular components using Backbase, the framework the platform was built on, making sure everything met compliance requirements.

experience.eprom_bullet_1: Took over manual workflows that had become too slow for the team's needs and replaced them with actual software.
experience.eprom_bullet_2: Dug into slow queries and backend calls and got overall load times down significantly.

projects.heading: Projects
projects.math_jenga_description: A game I built for fun that turned into a real project. It's a Jenga tower where each block has a math problem. Kids have to solve it to place the block. Has colorblind mode, keyboard nav, a lives system, and works in both English and Spanish.
projects.therapp_description: A platform built for therapists. They sign up with a subscription and get access to an exercise library, can build their own routines, manage their clients, schedule appointments, track each client's progress, and log observations over time.
projects.servitech_description: A platform I'm building for two Costa Rican businesses: Servitech and Macrobiotic Maná. Each brand gets its own view with product catalog, services, quote requests, and contact. The admin panel covers inventory, sales, distributors, categories, and quotes — all configurable per client. Quote generation runs through an AI agent orchestrated with n8n and Groq.
projects.negozia_description: A proof of concept for a point-of-sale interface. Built to explore Redux Toolkit patterns in a real sales context: browse product categories, add items to an active sale, manage multiple pending sales in parallel, and track totals in real time. Multilingual support included.
